routes.label: applied for through the DNR's portal or office

note: The State Minister responsible for the DNR, to Parliament's Committee on National Development and Heritage, as Edition.mv reported: a card for a person aged 10 to 40 is valid five years, an older person's ten; a permanent card from 65 was being prepared (not modelled). The fee is on the DNR's application form, which wasn't reached (the missions' pages refused this session), so it's null; so is the time. 40 itself is kept with the older.

sources.title: Edition.mv, on the DNR's plan for permanent identity cards from 65
sources.said: responded that the validity of identity cards for persons aged between 10 and 40 is five years, while those older receive a card with 10 year validity.
